topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing and overview for the lecture on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen and damage sensing via PAMPs and DAMPs
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular criteria and principles used by the innate immune system to identify infections and tissue damage while distinguishing self from non-self.

topics.label: Toll-like receptor biology and downstream signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the genetics, cellular localization, and transcriptional signaling pathways of Toll-like receptors in mediating immune defense.

topics.label: Cytoplasmic PRRs and inflammasome activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore intracellular pattern recognition receptors and the assembly of the multi-protein inflammasome structure to mature pro-inflammatory cytokines.

topics.label: Sentinel cell activation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the cellular execution of acute inflammation from sentinel cell activation and leukocyte extravasation to adaptive immune priming and systemic complications like sepsis.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the mechanisms that shut down acute inflammation, facilitate tissue healing, and lead to chronic inflammatory states or granuloma formation when unresolved.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing framing and previews the topic of the following lecture.
